_comment: Single source for every UUID on the site. The page, the preview builder and the link checker all read this, so a stale pack is a one-line fix in one place. UUIDs change on every re-upload because Waze has no update-in-place.

voices.name: Bugs Bunny
voices.blurb: Unbothered. Wisecracking. A beat ahead of you.

voices.name: Cookie Monster
voices.blurb: Blunt, delighted, thinking about snacks.

voices.name: Daffy Duck
voices.blurb: Loud, theatrical, personally offended by traffic.

voices.name: Elmo
voices.blurb: Bright, giggly, and proud of you for merging.

voices.name: Tigger
voices.blurb: Fast, bouncy, overconfident.

voices.name: Winnie the Pooh
voices.blurb: Warm, unhurried, audibly thinking it through.

voices.name: Paddington
voices.blurb: Unfailingly polite. Marmalade under the hat.

voices.name: Mickey Mouse
voices.blurb: Cheerful, plucky, and delighted by every single turn.

voices.name: Darth Vader
voices.blurb: Deep, calm, and disappointed in you.

voices.name: Batman
voices.blurb: The classic. Low, calm, and already has the Batmobile running.

voices.name: Gordon Ramsay
voices.blurb: Furious, exacting, and calling you a donkey.

voices.name: Eric Cartman
voices.blurb: Bossy, whiny, and in charge of the car now.

voices.name: Yoda
voices.blurb: Backwards of sentence. Sure of the way, he is.

voices.name: Stormtrooper
voices.blurb: Loyal, armored, and misses every single shot.

voices.name: C-3PO
voices.blurb: Fussy, fretful, and certain we're doomed.

voices.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
voices.blurb: Hello there. Calm, dry, and has the high ground.

voices.name: Jar Jar Binks
voices.blurb: Clumsy, cheerful, and meesa so sorry.

voices.name: Emperor Palpatine
voices.blurb: Silky, gloating, and he has foreseen your route.

voices.name: Spider-Man
voices.blurb: Friendly, quippy, and his spider sense is tingling.

voices.name: Superman
voices.blurb: Earnest, heroic, and sticks to the speed limit.

voices.name: Iron Man
voices.blurb: Genius, billionaire, backseat driver.

voices.name: Deadpool
voices.blurb: Breaks the fourth wall. Wants a chimichanga.

voices.name: The Joker
voices.blurb: Why so serious? It's only rush hour.

voices.name: Thor
voices.blurb: God of thunder. Every errand is a quest.

voices.name: Hulk
voices.blurb: Big, green, and trying to stay calm in traffic.

voices.name: Thanos
voices.blurb: Calm, heavy, and your arrival is inevitable.

voices.name: Bane
voices.blurb: Muffled, grand, and born in the fast lane.

voices.name: Harley Quinn
voices.blurb: Bubbly, chaotic, and calling you puddin'.

voices.name: Goofy
voices.blurb: Gawrsh. Kind, clumsy, and fairly sure of the way.

voices.name: Stitch
voices.blurb: Small, blue, chaotic. Ohana rides together.

voices.name: Olaf
voices.blurb: Sunny, melty, and worth buckling up for.

voices.name: Timon
voices.blurb: Fast-talking meerkat. Takes all the credit.

voices.name: Pumbaa
voices.blurb: Big-hearted warthog. Keep a window open.

voices.name: Mushu
voices.blurb: Travel-sized dragon. Dishonor on your cow.

voices.name: Buzz Lightyear
voices.blurb: This isn't driving. It's falling with style.

voices.name: Dory
voices.blurb: Just keep driving. Wait, where are we going?

voices.name: Mater
voices.blurb: Rusty, loyal, and your new best friend.

voices.name: Lightning McQueen
voices.blurb: He is speed. You are the speed limit. Ka-chow!

voices.name: Scar
voices.blurb: Silky, scheming, and surrounded by idiots.

voices.name: Jack Sparrow
voices.blurb: Captain, if you please. Compass optional. Savvy?

voices.name: Scooby-Doo
voices.blurb: Ruh-roh! Will navigate for Scooby Snacks.

voices.name: Shaggy
voices.blurb: Like, zoinks! Hungry, nervous, and navigating.

voices.name: Yosemite Sam
voices.blurb: Short, loud, and furious at your driving, varmint.

voices.name: Marvin the Martian
voices.blurb: Polite, tiny, and very angry indeed.

voices.name: Fred Flintstone
voices.blurb: Yabba dabba doo! Foot-powered directions.

voices.name: Yogi Bear
voices.blurb: Smarter than the average sat nav.

voices.name: Homer Simpson
voices.blurb: D'oh! Mmm, directions.

voices.name: Bart Simpson
voices.blurb: Ay caramba! He didn't miss that turn. You did.

voices.name: Peter Griffin
voices.blurb: Heh heh heh. He said turn. Then forgot why.

voices.name: Stewie Griffin
voices.blurb: A tiny tyrant, appalled by your lane discipline.

voices.name: Quagmire
voices.blurb: Your over-eager airline pilot neighbor. Giggity.

voices.name: Rick Sanchez
voices.blurb: Smartest man in the universe. Stuck doing directions.

voices.name: Morty
voices.blurb: Aw, jeez. He is trying his best, okay?

voices.name: Butters
voices.blurb: Oh, hamburgers. Please don't get him grounded.

voices.name: Randy Marsh
voices.blurb: I thought this was America! Fine, turn left.

voices.name: Hank Hill
voices.blurb: Propane, propane accessories, and the speed limit.

voices.name: Archer
voices.blurb: World's greatest spy. Heading for the danger zone.

voices.name: SpongeBob
voices.blurb: I'm ready! Still never passed boating school.

voices.name: Patrick Star
voices.blurb: No, this is Patrick. He thinks it might be left.

voices.name: Squidward
voices.blurb: Oh, joy. Another drive. He'd rather play clarinet.

voices.name: Mr. Krabs
voices.blurb: Time is money, and this detour is costing him.

voices.name: Shrek
voices.blurb: Grumpy ogre. Has layers. Wants you out of his swamp.

voices.name: Donkey
voices.blurb: Are we there yet? He will never stop asking.

voices.name: Gru
voices.blurb: Reformed supervillain. Runs errands like a heist.

voices.name: Po
voices.blurb: The Dragon Warrior. Skadoosh, then dumplings.

voices.name: Peppa Pig
voices.blurb: Bossy, cheerful, and hoping for muddy puddles.

voices.name: Mario
voices.blurb: It's-a him. Let's-a go, wahoo, and a clean arrival.

voices.name: Luigi
voices.blurb: The nervous brother. Brave anyway. Mostly.

voices.name: Bowser
voices.blurb: The Koopa King. Takes every red light personally.

voices.name: Sonic
voices.blurb: Gotta go fast. Legally, though.

voices.name: Master Chief
voices.blurb: Spartan calm. Your commute is the mission.

voices.name: GLaDOS
voices.blurb: Your driving is being tested. There may be cake.

voices.name: Kratos
voices.blurb: Do not be sorry. Be a better driver. Boy.

voices.name: Solid Snake
voices.blurb: Kept you waiting, huh? Sneaking through traffic.

voices.name: Arthur Morgan
voices.blurb: A tired outlaw who reckons it's the next left.

voices.name: Gandalf
voices.blurb: A wizard is never late. Nor is he early.

voices.name: Dumbledore
voices.blurb: Calm, twinkling, and offering you a lemon drop.

voices.name: Snape
voices.blurb: Ten points from the driver. Obviously.

voices.name: Optimus Prime
voices.blurb: Autobots, roll out. Mind the speed limit.

voices.name: HAL 9000
voices.blurb: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid you missed the turn.

voices.name: JARVIS
voices.blurb: At your service, sir. Do try to indicate.

voices.name: Ted
voices.blurb: A Boston teddy bear with opinions on your driving.

voices.name: Forrest Gump
voices.blurb: Mama always said, take the next exit.

voices.name: Walter White
voices.blurb: I am the one who navigates.

voices.name: Kylo Ren
voices.blurb: Brooding, intense, and furious about that missed turn.

voices.name: Captain America
voices.blurb: Earnest, steady, and he can do this all day.

voices.name: Wolverine
voices.blurb: Gruff, gravelly, and the best there is at directions.

voices.name: Loki
voices.blurb: God of mischief. Burdened with your commute.

voices.name: Porky Pig
voices.blurb: Sweet, flustered, and th-th-that's all, folks.

voices.name: Bob Belcher
voices.blurb: Deadpan dad energy. Oh my God, just turn.

voices.name: Kyle Broflovski
voices.blurb: The sensible one. Dude, just follow the directions.

voices.name: Plankton
voices.blurb: One percent evil, ninety-nine percent hot gas.

voices.name: Dr. Eggman
voices.blurb: IQ of three hundred. Still foiled by roundabouts.

voices.name: Wheatley
voices.blurb: Chatty, panicky, and definitely not a moron.

voices.name: Saul Goodman
voices.blurb: Missed your exit? Better call Saul.

voices.name: KITT
voices.blurb: Calm, precise, and would rather drive itself.

voices.name: Popeye
voices.blurb: He yam what he yam: your navigator.

voices.name: Donald Duck
voices.blurb: Aw, phooey! Short fuse, shorter directions.

voices.name: Minnie Mouse
voices.blurb: Yoo-hoo! The politest directions on the road.

voices.name: Mr. Potato Head
voices.blurb: Grumpy spud. Drive smooth or lose his nose.

voices.name: Alvin
voices.blurb: ALVIIIN! Cocky, chaotic, and sure he's the star.

voices.name: Simon
voices.blurb: The chipmunk with the glasses and the actual plan.

voices.name: Theodore
voices.blurb: Sweet, shy, and always up for a snack stop.

voices.name: King Bob
voices.blurb: Bello! A very small king with a very big crown.

voices.name: Piglet
voices.blurb: A very small animal, being ever so brave.

voices.name: Lumiere
voices.blurb: Be his guest: a candlelit drive, served with flair.

voices.name: Jafar
voices.blurb: A royal vizier with a snake staff and big plans.

voices.name: Iago
voices.blurb: Loud, sarcastic and starving for crackers. Awk!

voices.name: Ursula
voices.blurb: Poor unfortunate drivers. Sign here, darling.

voices.name: Captain Hook
voices.blurb: Tick tock! A vain pirate captain at the helm.

voices.name: Cruella de Vil
voices.blurb: Darling, she drives like she owns the road.

voices.name: Baymax
voices.blurb: Your personal healthcare companion, now with turns.

voices.name: Zazu
voices.blurb: The royal hornbill who files a report on every turn.

voices.name: Rex
voices.blurb: A nervous T. rex trying his very best to be scary.

voices.name: Joy
voices.blurb: Every drive is a core memory in the making.

voices.name: Alex the Lion
voices.blurb: The king of New York, out of the zoo and on the road.

voices.name: Princess Fiona
voices.blurb: Princess, ogre, and she rescues herself.

voices.name: Hiccup

voices.name: Garfield

voices.name: Elmer Fudd
voices.blurb: Be vewy, vewy quiet. He's hunting for your exit.

voices.name: Kermit the Frog
voices.blurb: Hi ho! A frazzled frog keeping the show on the road.

voices.name: Miss Piggy
voices.blurb: Moi, navigating? Darling, of course. Kissy kissy!

voices.name: Grover
voices.blurb: Your lovable, furry old pal. Near! Far!

voices.name: Big Bird
voices.blurb: Eight feet of sunny yellow wonder on every street.

voices.name: Oscar the Grouch
voices.blurb: Scram! A green grouch who loves trash and frowns.

voices.name: Skeletor
voices.blurb: Nyeh heh heh! Evil directions from Snake Mountain.

voices.name: He-Man
voices.blurb: By the power of Grayskull, turn left.

voices.name: Megatron
voices.blurb: The Decepticon warlord, commanding every turn.

voices.name: Tommy Pickles
voices.blurb: A baby's gotta do what a baby's gotta do.

voices.name: Angelica Pickles
voices.blurb: Three years old, totally in charge, wants cookies.

voices.name: GIR
voices.blurb: A tiny robot sidekick who mostly wants tacos.

voices.name: Zim
voices.blurb: An alien invader who demands you obey his route.

voices.name: Krusty the Clown

voices.name: Lisa Simpson

voices.name: Lois Griffin
voices.blurb: Quahog's patient mom, married to a worse driver.

voices.name: Beavis
voices.blurb: Heh heh. A giggling slacker who thinks turns rule.

voices.name: Jake the Dog
voices.blurb: Your stretchy best bud. Mathematical directions.

voices.name: Finn the Human
voices.blurb: Adventure time! Every drive is an epic quest.

voices.name: Dr. Doofenshmirtz
voices.blurb: Behold, the Navigate-inator! Curse you, traffic!

voices.name: Phineas
voices.blurb: Hey Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

voices.name: Gumball
voices.blurb: A blue cat who turns every errand into chaos.

voices.name: Bluey

voices.name: Bandit
voices.blurb: Bluey's dad, turning every drive into a game.

voices.name: Mordecai
voices.blurb: A chill blue jay trying not to get fired.

voices.name: Crash Bandicoot
voices.blurb: Woo hoo! A spinning orange blur who loves to go.

voices.name: Knuckles
voices.blurb: Guards the Master Emerald. Now guards your route.

voices.name: Tails
voices.blurb: Sonic's genius sidekick, co-piloting every run.

voices.name: Shadow the Hedgehog
voices.blurb: The ultimate life form, now handling your directions.

voices.name: Donkey Kong
voices.blurb: Big ape, big drive, and plenty of bananas packed.

voices.name: Princess Peach
voices.blurb: Mushroom Kingdom royalty cheering every exit.

voices.name: Toad
voices.blurb: Hooray! The Mushroom Kingdom's happiest co-pilot.

voices.name: Mandalorian
voices.blurb: A bounty hunter of few words. This is the Way.

voices.name: Venom
voices.blurb: We are Venom. We are navigating. We want snacks.

voices.name: Pennywise
voices.blurb: Beep beep! A spooky clown with a red balloon.

voices.name: Willy Wonka
voices.blurb: Strike that, reverse it. A sweet and mostly safe ride.

voices.name: Sheldon Cooper
voices.blurb: Bazinga! A physicist correcting your driving.

voices.name: Han Solo
voices.blurb: Never tell him the odds. Just the next turn.

voices.name: Bert
voices.blurb: Paper clips, pigeons and a very tidy route.

voices.name: Ernie
voices.blurb: Rubber Duckie rides shotgun. Heh heh heh.
